name: what is 72px tall in the header
exact deck slack
eval: (function(){var d=document.querySelector('#deck');var db=d.getBoundingClientRect();var cs=getComputedStyle(d);var used=0,n=0;Array.prototype.forEach.call(d.children,function(c){used+=c.getBoundingClientRect().height;n++});var gaps=(n-1)*parseFloat(cs.rowGap||0);var pad=parseFloat(cs.paddingTop)+parseFloat(cs.paddingBottom);return 'deck '+Math.round(db.height)+' = children '+Math.round(used)+' + gaps '+gaps+' + padding '+pad+' = '+Math.round(used+gaps+pad)+'   SLACK '+Math.round(db.height-(used+gaps+pad))})()

name: macro gloss on one line?
eval: (function(){var out=[];Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.mac .ms'),function(e){var cs=getComputedStyle(e);var probe=e.cloneNode(true);probe.style.cssText='position:absolute;visibility:hidden;height:auto;white-space:nowrap;font:'+cs.font;document.body.appendChild(probe);out.push(Math.round(probe.getBoundingClientRect().width));probe.remove()});return 'gloss widths on one line: '+out.join(', ')+'  (cell text width available ~'+Math.round(document.querySelector('.mac').getBoundingClientRect().width-14)+')'})()
